_meta.purpose: Line items most often missed on adjuster roof/siding estimates, for the app's claim screen to prompt per stage (round 20 research). Not Nebraska-audited figures - vendor/trade-press sources, confidence noted per item.
_meta.legal_note: HMP documents damage, cites code, and submits a supplement WITH photos/measurements. HMP never negotiates the claim settlement for the homeowner or represents the homeowner to the insurer as their agent - that is public-adjuster work (Neb. Rev. Stat. 44-9201 to 44-9219, license required). HMP never promises insurance will pay, and never touches the deductible (44-8604).

items.name_es: Goterón / drip edge (aleros y bordes laterales)
items.when_it_applies: Every roof replacement - required by code, but adjusters often price it only on the eaves, not the rakes, or leave it off entirely
proof_needed: Photo of existing drip edge condition (or its absence) before tear-off
Linear footage measurement, eaves + rakes separately
items.code_ref: IRC R905.2.8.5 (via Nebraska's adopted IRC, local amendments may vary - unverified this round, egress blocked)

items.when_it_applies: Every roof replacement - manufacturers require a real starter product for shingle warranty, adjusters sometimes fold it into 'field shingles' and drop the separate cost
proof_needed: Linear footage of eaves + rakes
Manufacturer install instructions showing starter strip is required for warranty (attach as backup)

items.name_es: Membrana de hielo y agua (donde el codigo lo exige)
items.when_it_applies: Cold-climate code zones per IRC Table R301.2(1) - required at eaves (extend 24in inside the exterior wall line) where there's history of ice damming; also valleys per most manufacturer specs
proof_needed: Photo of old underlayment/eaves during tear-off
Note the local jurisdiction's adopted code amendment if it strengthens the base IRC requirement
items.code_ref: IRC R905.1.2 (Nebraska adopts IRC with local amendments; Omaha is confirmed to amend R301.2 to require ice & water at eaves - verify Fremont's own amendment, unverified this round)

items.name_en: Step and counter flashing (walls, chimneys, dormers)
items.when_it_applies: Any roof-to-wall or roof-to-chimney intersection - code requires new flashing when the roof covering is replaced, reusing old flashing is a common adjuster shortcut
proof_needed: Photo of each intersection
Linear footage per intersection
Note if old flashing is rusted/damaged - stronger case for full replacement not reuse
items.code_ref: IRC R903.2 (flashing required at wall/roof intersections) - unverified page text this round

items.name_en: Ridge vent (cut-in ventilation, not just ridge cap)
items.when_it_applies: When the existing roof has ridge vent - adjusters sometimes price ridge cap shingles but not the vent product underneath, or omit the cut-in labor
proof_needed: Photo of existing ridge vent before tear-off
Linear footage of ridge
items.code_ref: IRC R806 attic ventilation (net free area requirement) - unverified this round

items.name_en: Pipe jacks / plumbing boots (all penetrations, not just one)
items.name_es: Botas de tuberia / pipe jacks (todas las salidas)
items.when_it_applies: Every roof with plumbing vent penetrations - adjusters sometimes price only one pipe boot when there are several sizes/locations
proof_needed: Photo + count of every roof penetration
Note size of each (1.5in, 2in, 3in, 4in are different products/prices)

items.name_en: Satellite dish / solar attachment detach and reset
items.name_es: Desmontar y reinstalar antena satelital / paneles solares
items.when_it_applies: Any roof-mounted dish or solar hardware in the tear-off area, when the same storm event caused the roof damage
proof_needed: Photo of the mounted equipment before tear-off
Note it must come down for tear-off regardless of whether it was itself storm-damaged

items.name_en: Gutter apron (flashing behind the gutter, under the drip edge)
items.when_it_applies: Any roof with gutters - a separate flashing piece from drip edge, frequently priced as one line when it should be two
proof_needed: Photo showing gutter + roof edge condition
Linear footage along all gutter runs

items.name_en: Overhead & Profit (O&P), 10%+10%, when 3+ trades are involved
items.name_es: Gastos generales y ganancia (O&P), cuando hay 3 o mas oficios
items.when_it_applies: Job involves 3+ trades needing coordination (e.g. roofing + siding + gutters, or roofing + a separate electrician for a mast/weatherhead) - carriers often strip O&P claiming the contractor self-performs; this is an insurance-industry convention (not a Nebraska statute) but Xactimate itself calculates it by default
proof_needed: List every trade involved on the job and why each needs separate scheduling/coordination
Point out in writing (email, not verbal negotiation) that Xactimate's own line-item calc includes O&P by default

items.name_es: Costo de actualizacion por codigo (cobertura de ordenanza/ley)
items.when_it_applies: When the current code requires something the old roof/siding didn't have (e.g. a stronger ice barrier than was there before, or a permit-triggered upgrade) - most policies have a separate 'ordinance or law' coverage line for this, often unused because nobody points to the code section
proof_needed: Cite the exact code section
Photo of the old (non-compliant) condition
Note the policy's ordinance-or-law coverage line if the declarations page has one
items.code_ref: Varies by item - cite the specific IRC/local amendment section that changed

items.name_en: Siding matching / full-elevation or full-house replacement when exact match is unavailable
items.name_es: Igualar el revestimiento / reemplazo completo cuando no hay material identico
items.when_it_applies: Damaged siding profile/color/exposure is discontinued or unavailable - Nebraska's own matching regulation (Neb. Admin. Code Title 210, Ch. 60, Sec 010.01(B)) requires the insurer to replace enough to create a 'reasonably uniform appearance' at no added cost to the insured over the deductible
proof_needed: Discontinuation letter or manufacturer confirmation the exact product/color/profile is unavailable
Photos comparing old vs. any close substitute
Cite the Nebraska matching regulation by name (this is a Nebraska-specific rule, stronger than generic supplement asks)
items.code_ref: Neb. Admin. Code Title 210, Ch. 60, Sec 010.01(B) - VERIFY THE EXACT TEXT AT nebraskalegislature.gov OR sos.nebraska.gov NEXT ROUND (search-summary only this round, egress blocked to primary source)

items.name_es: Envoltura de la casa / barrera contra el clima (house wrap)
items.when_it_applies: Every siding tear-off - code requires a new weather-resistive barrier when siding comes off, adjusters sometimes leave it off the scope entirely
proof_needed: Photo of existing wrap condition during tear-off
Square footage of the wall area
items.code_ref: IRC R703.2 (weather-resistive barrier required) - unverified this round

items.name_en: J-channel, starter strip, undersill trim, corner posts, window/door casing trim (siding)
items.name_es: J-channel, tira de inicio, moldura bajo alero, esquineros, molduras de ventanas/puertas
items.when_it_applies: Every siding job - trim pieces are frequently priced as one bundled line ($300-800 per elevation, $1,500-3,500 whole house per one source, unverified/unaudited) when each should be its own item
proof_needed: Photo of each trim type
Linear footage per type

items.name_en: Detach and reset of fixtures (light fixtures, shutters, house numbers, downspouts)
items.name_es: Desmontar y reinstalar accesorios (luces, contraventanas, numeros de casa, bajantes)
items.when_it_applies: Anything mounted to the wall/eave in the work area that must come off and go back on
proof_needed: Photo of each fixture before tear-off

items.when_it_applies: Whenever the local jurisdiction requires a permit for re-roof/re-side (check Fremont's requirement) - a real, invoiced cost, often left off the scope
proof_needed: The permit fee receipt/invoice once pulled

items.name_es: Contenedor de basura / retiro de escombros
items.when_it_applies: Every tear-off job - sometimes priced too low for the actual size/number of loads needed
proof_needed: Photo of dumpster size/load
Actual hauler invoice if it exceeds the estimate

items.name_es: Recargo por techo inclinado y por altura/segundo piso
items.when_it_applies: Roof pitch above the standard threshold (commonly 7/12+) or height above one story - line-item pricing tools (Xactimate) have separate add-on categories for this that adjusters sometimes don't apply
proof_needed: Photo showing pitch (use a pitch gauge) and height
Note the pitch/story count on the scope comparison sheet

contractor_may: Document damage with photos/measurements and provide them to the insurer
Point to specific code sections that require an item the estimate is missing
Meet the adjuster on-site and show/point out damage in person
Submit a written supplement request with photos, measurements, and a code citation for each added item
Ask, in writing, for O&P when 3+ trades are involved and note that Xactimate's own default calculation includes it
contractor_may_not_without_a_public_adju: Negotiate the claim settlement amount on the homeowner's behalf as their representative (that is 'adjusting' under the Public Adjusters Licensing Act, Neb. Rev. Stat. 44-9201 to 44-9219)
Represent to the insurer that you are acting FOR the insured in effecting a settlement
Promise the homeowner a specific claim outcome or dollar amount
Offer, waive, or rebate any part of the homeowner's deductible (44-8604) - never frame a supplement or upgrade as 'we'll eat the difference' language that touches the deductible
verify_next_round: Exact statute text of 44-9204 (only a search summary this round, egress to nebraskalegislature.gov blocked - matches round 15/18's same limitation)
Exact Neb. Admin. Code Title 210 Ch. 60 Sec 010.01(B) matching regulation text
Fremont/Dodge County's own adopted IRC edition and any local amendments to R301.2/R905 (ice barrier, drip edge) - the up.codes page that would show this was blocked this round

documents_adjusters_typically_want: Full photo set of every damaged slope/elevation, dated
Measurements (roof report or manual measurements: squares, linear ft of eaves/rakes/ridge/valleys/flashing)
A line-by-line comparison: insurer's scope vs. what the photos/measurements show is actually needed
Manufacturer installation instructions when an item is required for warranty (starter strip, ice barrier)
Code citation for any code-required item not in the original scope
Discontinuation letter/manufacturer confirmation for siding matching claims
Claim number, date of loss, and adjuster contact on every document sent
